# Gadget Grade

## Definition

How good a Gadget is. Exercises a notation column and a value that needs slugging.

## Values

| Value | Stable code | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fine | F | Works. |
| Novel / Unusual | N | Works in a way worth noticing. |
| Poor | P | Does not work. |
